From: Jane Durham <jane.durham@glaciobank.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.company>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and DR runbook for procurement

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the demo last week — procurement asked us to collect a focused recovery package before we proceed to contracting. Specifically they want: 

- A single-page RTO/RPO matrix by service (API, embeddings, console, auth) with measured targets and test results where available.
- A short DR runbook (high-level steps for failover, rollback, and restore).
- Evidence of most recent DR test and any post-mortem or follow-up items.

Can you send those artifacts (PDF/Excel) and any links to your SOC 2 attestation? We have a 3-business-day target from Legal to close the security checklist for this procurement wave.

If there are constraints on sharing full-runbooks we can accept redacted versions and a statement of controls.

Appreciate a quick reply,

Jane Durham
Vendor Risk Manager — Glacio Bank
jane.durham@glaciobank.com

Subject: RTO/RPO matrix and evidence — initial draft

Hi Jane / Alex — attaching the initial artifacts and a short summary. I included measured/target values and the last test dates we have in-house.

Summary (high level):
- API inference (hosted): RTO target 15 minutes, measured failover ~12m in last tabletop (2025-11-03). RPO target 0-5s for in-flight sessions (KV cache best-effort) and up to 5min for async logs.
- Embeddings pipeline: RTO target 2 hours (cold-start of batch workers), RPO 15 minutes (snapshot cadence).
- Console & management plane: RTO target 30 minutes, RPO 1 hour (stateful UI session restore is best-effort).
- Auth & key services: RTO 5 minutes (redundant multi-AZ), RPO 0 (highly available).

Backups and retention: daily incremental snapshots + weekly full snapshots retained 90 days in primary region, replicated daily to DR region and retained 365 days for compliance artifacts. We can include the S3 lifecycle policy if that helps.

Attachments (shared):
- DR-Runbook-summary.pdf (PDF, 220 KB) — high-level steps for detection → failover → cutback.
- BCP-RTO-RPO-matrix.xlsx (Excel, 48 KB) — table by service/region, includes last test date.
- s3-presigned-glaciobank.zip (link, expires in 7 days) — redacted logs and test results (redaction applied).

Link to artifacts: https://drive.redwood.company/shared/GlacioBank/BCP-2026 (read-only)

If you want the raw playbooks we can provide them under an NDA or via a redacted package.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
